description: Upgrades a CockroachDB cluster by replacing the binary on each node in a rolling fashion. Version finalization (SET CLUSTER SETTING version) is a separate irreversible step controlled by auto_finalize.

target_version.label: Target Version
target_version.description: Target CockroachDB version (e.g. 23.2). Must be +1 minor.

auto_finalize.label: Auto-Finalize Version
auto_finalize.description: If true, SET CLUSTER SETTING version is executed automatically after binary upgrade. Irreversible. Default: false — operator must explicitly finalize.

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Run preflight checks only — no changes applied

rollback.description: Before version finalization: reinstall old binary on each node in reverse order. After finalization: irreversible — restore from backup.
